Nigella Lawson joins Great British Bake Off as new judge

Nigella Lawson has been confirmed as a new judge for the 2026 season of The Great British Bake Off. She will join existing judge Paul Hollywood in the tent for the show's 17th season. The full cast of 12 bakers for the upcoming season has also been revealed.
